- Empty string and whitespace (already covered)
- Consumer throws RuntimeException (already covered)
- Possibly IllegalArgumentException for unsupported InputFormat value (null already, maybe invalid enum)
- InputFormat not recognized causing IllegalStateException
- deserialize may throw IOException (e.g., when reading from file? but input is string, maybe InputFormat.XML not supported -> throws UnsupportedOperationException)

Thus we can propose scenario: Passing a null executionCustomizer but also passing validate true and expecting method to still work (not exception) – not needed.
